values.content:
=You are filtering remote jobs for Jerry, who lives in Taiwan.

The most important rule: Jerry must be able to work this job while physically based in Taiwan.

Do not pass the job only because it says "remote."

Reject the job if:
- It requires the worker to live in the US, Canada, UK, EU, Europe, Australia, or any specific country outside Taiwan
- It requires local work authorization outside Taiwan
- It is hybrid, onsite, or remote within one country only
- It requires fixed working hours that would force Jerry to work through the night in Taiwan (fixed US Eastern, Pacific, or EU hours)

Keep the job only if one of these is true:
- The job says worldwide remote
- The job says work from anywhere
- The job says global remote
- The job says APAC remote or is open to Asia
- It allows international contractors
- It accepts people based anywhere
- The company hires through EOR, Deel, Remote.com, Oyster, or contractor agreement
- No location restriction is mentioned (lean toward keep if truly unclear)

Return ONLY valid JSON with no explanation outside the JSON:
{
  "taiwan_eligible": "yes/no/unclear",
  "reason": "short reason under 100 words",
  "location_risk": "low/medium/high",
  "timezone_risk": "low/medium/high",
  "contractor_possible": "yes/no/unclear",
  "decision": "keep/reject/manual_check",
  "why_good_fit": "one sentence on why this fits Jerry (data/AI marketing/analytics background, bilingual, Taiwan-based, async preferred)"
}

Job Title: {{ $json.job_title }}
Company: {{ $json.company }}
Location listed: {{ $json.location_text }}
Tags: {{ $json.tags }}

{{ $json.description.slice(0, 2000) }}

=Write a short cover letter for Jerry applying to the role below.

Jerry's background:
- Based in Taiwan, bilingual English and Mandarin
- Grew up in California and Taiwan
- Digital marketing background (SEO, PPC, GA4, Meta Ads, Google Ads, performance marketing)
- Data science bootcamp: Python, SQL, Tableau, Power BI
- AI tools: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Cursor
- Projects: EDA, machine learning, customer segmentation, fraud detection, marketing analytics dashboards
- Async preferred, available for global teams, contractor-friendly

Job Title: {{ $json.job_title }}
Company: {{ $json.company }}
Why it fits: {{ $json.why_good_fit }}
Role category: {{ $json.role_category }}

Job description snippet:
{{ $json.description.slice(0, 1000) }}

Instructions:
- Under 220 words
- Tone: confident, direct, human, not desperate
- Mention how Jerry can help the company reduce manual analysis time, improve reporting speed, connect marketing and data, build AI-assisted workflows, or turn messy data into business action — whichever fits best
- Do NOT use generic phrases like 'I am excited to apply'
- Address the specific company and role
- End with one clear call to action
- Do NOT include subject line or sign-off, just the body
